title: Improvement record (feedback/improvements.jsonl, one JSON object per line)

decision.description: What was changed and why — smallest source fix that addresses the finding.

changedFiles.description: Paths relative to lab root. Must be source (skill/template/harness), never generated app/ or runs/.

regressionCaseId.description: Case under evaluation/cases/ that guards against re-occurrence.

verifiedByRunId.description: Run that re-executed the same input and passed. Required before the linked finding may be marked verified.
